Method of Attack: Web cache deception attack that exploits caching servers caching incorrect page content including personal details when accessing non-existent resources
Caching servers cache pages with personal data when user accesses URLs with non-existent resources, allowing attackers to retrieve cached personal data by accessing malformed URLs
Attack Vector: Accessing URLs pointing to non-existent resources (e.g., CSS, JS, AVI, DOC, JPEG, AIFF extensions) causing servers to cache pages with personal data
Convincing users to access malformed URLs that cause caching of personal data
Retrieving cached pages via malformed URLs without authentication
